officialName: Trotec Speedy 400 laser engraving system (CO2; also sold as Speedy 400 flexx with an added fiber laser)
description: The Speedy 400 is a large enclosed flatbed CO2 laser that cuts and engraves sheet materials. In a makerspace it is used to cut wood, acrylic, paper and leather, and to engrave signs, panels and prototypes up to about 1 m wide. Jobs are sent from Ruby software, and an ultrasonic autofocus sets the focus height. On the flexx version, a second fiber laser can also mark bare metals.

specs.label: Max. workpiece height
specs.value: 305 mm (12 in) with 1.5 in or 2.0 in lens; less with longer lenses

specs.label: Laser source
specs.value: CO2, 10.6 µm wavelength, 60–120 W depending on configuration; flexx adds a 30–50 W fiber laser

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±0.015 mm over the whole working area; 5 µm addressable

specs.label: Electrical
specs.value: 1~ AC 110–230 V, 50/60 Hz, approx. 1200–2100 W depending on laser power

materials: bare metals (marking only, flexx fiber laser)
useRestrictions: Only trained users may run it, with the lid closed and the exhaust running, and they must stay at the machine for the whole job because cutting can catch fire.
